payload.title: Vedam School of Technology BTech CS and AI at ADYPU Pune Fees Curriculum Placements

sections.heading: Findings
sections.body: The Apple Macbook is included in the course fee [E1]. The fees mentioned in the table are the course fees [E2]. This is exclusive of Hostel & Mess fees [E3]. Additional fees payable directly to the University, over and above the course fee: one-time Application Fee (₹1,500), Registration Fee (₹5,000), Uniform Fee (₹5,000), Sports Activity Fee (₹5,000), and Examination Fee (₹3,000 per semester) [E4].
